# Partially anchored pair results

Independently authored Java8 factories retain one invariant Iterator<V> input and
an opaque closed context, while K remains independent in Map<K,V>. The frozen
observer checks exact input/context references, original iterator and provider
actions, failures, casts and ignored calls. All source and SDK output units
compile with original Signatures, definitions, roles and Exceptions compared.
Private application bytes and behavior are excluded.
